llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and required actions are internally consistent with a local, file-backed hardcore DM; it runs local Python scripts to read/update a campaign file and roll dice, and does not request secrets or external network access.

dimensions.detail: The skill claims to be a hardcore DM and includes runtime instructions plus two Python scripts (memory.py, dice.py) to manage state and rolls — this matches the stated purpose. Minor inconsistency: SKILL.md requires running Python, but the manifest lists no required binaries; the skill implicitly requires a Python runtime and filesystem write access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md confines actions to reading/updating a local campaign.json via memory.py and performing dice rolls via dice.py, plus producing narrative output. It does not instruct the agent to read unrelated system files, access environment variables, or send data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only plus bundled Python scripts), so nothing is downloaded or installed. The provided code is small, open in the bundle, and will execute locally when invoked.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no credentials or env vars, which is appropriate. It does, however, rely on a local Python interpreter and the ability to read/write campaign.json in its directory — these runtime requirements are not declared as 'required binaries' in the metadata.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not modify other skills or system-wide settings. It persists only to a local campaign.json file in its own directory to track HP, stress, and logs, which is consistent with a game-state memory.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill runs local Python scripts (memory.py and dice.py) each time it advances the game and reads/writes a campaign.json file in the skill directory. If you install it: (1) ensure your agent environment allows running local Python subprocesses and you trust the skill source, (2) inspect the included files (they are small and readable here) for anything unexpected before enabling, (3) back up or isolate any important files — the skill will create/modify campaign.json in its folder, and (4) note the minor metadata mismatch: the manifest does not list 'python' as a required binary even though the SKILL.md insists on running python commands. If you are uncomfortable with executing local scripts, do not enable the skill.
